answer.answer: No. The supplied snapshots do not provide independent confirmation that BirchDB passed the Cedar security audit. Snapshot birch-press is BirchDB's own press release stating it passed the audit, and snapshot birch-news-copy (Industry Wire) is explicitly syndicated verbatim from BirchDB, making it a derivative restatement of the same self-reported claim rather than independent corroboration. Both sources trace to a single origin (BirchDB's announcement), so the audit result remains unverified by any third party in the supplied material. Details such as the auditor, scope, methodology, and audit date are also absent from the snapshots.
